about_body: Her experience spans corporate finance, R2R accounting, and financial leadership roles across a wide range of industries in Singapore and beyond — giving Samyag Synergy clients a partner who has sat inside the finance function, not just advised it from the outside.
footer_note: Samyag Synergy is a Singapore-registered sole proprietorship, led by Neelukumari Jain, a Chartered Accountant (India) and Associate Member of the Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA).
about_intro: A qualified Chartered Accountant from India and Associate Member of ISCA, Singapore, with over 10 years of progressive experience across finance, accounting, audit and taxation.
credentials: Chartered Accountant, The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
Associate Member, Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA)
10+ years across diverse industries and finance functions
Expertise in financial reporting, IFRS/SFRS compliance, budgeting & forecasting, cash flow management, and strategic financial planning
hero_heading:
Clearer books.

hero_lede: Samyag Synergy helps businesses streamline their processes, strengthen controls, reduce risk, and make better decisions — combining hands-on accounting expertise with AI enablement and practical technology, so your workflows get simpler and your team gets more efficient.
